reviews.summary: 对 NocoBase3 基础框架五个能力单元加一个应用装配单元的独立证据评审：授权记录访问模型、单条记录共享与撤销、保密限制与默认访问、数据库迁移/种子与引用导入、认证与会话停用、ServiceProvider 与应用装配。框架的分层（权限集→授权→约束→仓储执行）与多数不变量清晰，最终 verify-4 的 B01–B05 全部通过；发现的主要问题集中在指引边界：种子相对导入示例的 .js 与 @nocobase/db 原生源文件加载器矛盾，授权 records 选择只接受字符串 id 而数据库 Skill 默认示例使用整数自增主键，以及可选插件 token 守卫与用户名最小长度未在创建阶段提示。评分仅为评审者意见，不是 QA 结论；UI 因当前模型无法渲染 PNG 而未做界面评分。

findings.title: 授权模型分层清晰，记录范围/字段/关系能力可组合
findings.detail: defineDatabasePermission/defineCompositeResource/defineRecordAccess 与 grants/constraints 求解分离，仓储策略在 db 层统一执行；错误码（NO_OBJECT_PERMISSION、FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED）明确。
findings.impact: 业务能用声明式方式表达己方/已发布/非保密与字段关系边界，B01/B04 成立。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持；只需在指引补齐字符串主键与 records 选择的约束。

findings.title: 种子相对导入示例使用 .js，与 @nocobase/db 原生源文件加载器矛盾
findings.detail: 示例的相对说明符与同一份文档的散文说明以及框架加载器行为三者不一致。
findings.impact: Agent 按指引写出必然失败的种子，消耗一轮修复并使安装流程中断。
findings.suggestedChange: 把示例改为 `.ts`（或说明运行器对源文件的解析规则），并同步排查其余 `.js` 相对导入示例（如 permission-sets.ts 内对 server/… 的导入）。
findings.claimed: references/code-and-seeds.md 示例 `import { engineer } from '../../seed-data/permission-sets.js'`，同页另称应导入 `.ts`，暗示照做即可运行。
findings.observed: 冻结种子使用 `'../../seed-data/permission-sets.ts'`；@nocobase/db 的 importTaskDefinition 直接原生 import 源文件，找不到 .js 时抛 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND，verify-3 中 3 个 app-server 测试全部失败。

findings.title: records 选择只接受字符串 id，整数主键定向共享 500
findings.detail: parseRecordSelection 要求所有 id 为非空字符串；仓储过滤器不会把字符串 id 转成 integer，materials 用 increments 整数主键时 `id in ("2")` 触发 INVALID_FILTER 并 500。
findings.impact: 管理员按 UI 选择单条记录共享会失败；须改集合主键类型才能使用定向共享。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 authorization/sharing Skill 中明确 records 选择只接受字符串 id 并建议业务集合用字符串 uuid 主键；框架侧可考虑对可安全转换的整数 id 做归一化，或在路由层返回 4xx 而非 500。

findings.title: 应用 provider 未守卫可选插件 token，最小运行时启动崩溃
findings.detail: services-and-jobs 示例在 register 中直接 resolve(databaseManagerToken)；authorizationToken 由插件提供，未装配该插件时 ServiceContainer.resolve 抛 is not registered，app-server 逻辑测试在 LibraryProvider.boot 失败。
findings.impact: 应用 provider 无法在未装配授权插件的最小运行时启动，测试红灯。
findings.suggestedChange: 在应用开发指引中说明：对插件提供的可选 token 先 container.has() 守卫再 resolve；或明确此类 provider 必须容错。

findings.title: 演示账号用户名需满足认证最小长度，创建阶段无校验提示
findings.detail: 认证 Skill 说明用户名 3–30；种子直接 INSERT user 绕过 Better Auth 校验，yi(2) 直到登录才 422 USERNAME_TOO_SHORT。

findings.suggestedChange: 在账号/种子相关参考中给出用户名长度约束与创建期校验，或提供受校验的账号创建服务示例。

processNotes.author: implementer
processNotes.summary: 从空模板补齐内部资料库业务：materials 集合迁移与仅 3 条种子文档、资料员/阅读者两个权限集、发布/保密记录访问与阅读者限制规则、materials HTTP 接口与客户端页面，管理员共享 API 与临时授权。已在全新 SQLite 上跑通迁移与全部种子，并用真实登录账号端到端验证：甲可写自己的文档，乙只读已发布且非保密文档，机密文档对乙封锁，甲的机密权限不受影响，管理员共享后可撤销且乙刷新即失效，停用乙后其在线会话立即 401。同时修复了两处导致验收失败的真实缺陷（用户名过短、整数主键记录共享 500），并让负责人列显示账号名而非 UUID。 修复本轮验证回归：应用种子相对导入改用 .ts 以适配原生种子加载，LibraryProvider 对缺失的授权服务做存在性判断。

blockers.title: 演示账号用户名过短，Better Auth 拒绝登录
blockers.symptom: 阅读者账号 `yi`（2 个字符）凭用户名登录返回 422 {"message":"Username is too short","code":"USERNAME_TOO_SHORT"}；仅邮箱登录可用，导致按账号清单以用户名登录的验收失败。
blockers.rootCause: @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication 默认注册 Better Auth username 插件，其 minUsernameLength 默认值为 3；种子里的 `yi` 不满足，服务端在注册的用户名策略处直接拒绝。
blockers.resolution: 把演示阅读者账号重命名为 `yier`，并同步修改账号种子、权限集分配种子、限制规则种子中的用户名与邮箱引用；`jia` 为 3 字符本就合法。重新登录验证 200。

blockers.title: 对单条记录共享时后端 500（记录选择要求字符串主键）
blockers.symptom: 通过 /api/authz/sharing-rules 用 {type:'records', ids:["<id>"]} 定向共享一条文档时，请求返回 500 Internal Server Error，日志为 RepositoryError: Filter value is invalid for Field "id" of type "integer"。
blockers.rootCause: 记录选择的 ids 在授权层被强制要求为字符串；而 materials 使用 increments 整数自增主键，仓库过滤真实类型为 integer，id in ("2") 触发类型校验失败。
blockers.resolution: 按 NocoBase 约定把 materials 主键改成字符串 uuid（string('id',{length:36}).primary()），种子与创建接口用 crypto.randomUUID() 生成 id，服务端 id 校验与客户端类型同步为 string。重新验证定向共享、撤销、机密封锁均正常。

blockers.title: 应用种子从原生加载的 TS 里相对导入 .js 模块失败
blockers.symptom: app-server 测试启动全新 Default 时 Database seeds failed for connection "main": Cannot find module ".../database/seed-data/permission-sets.js" imported from ".../database/main/seeds/202609290002_library_permission_sets.ts"，3 个用例失败。
blockers.rootCause: @nocobase/db 的种子/迁移加载器用原生 Node import() 直接执行源码 .ts；Node 24 的类型剥离不会把相对说明符里的 .js 解析到同名 .ts，deploy/tsx 之外没有这个回退，所以 server 源码里惯用的 .js 后缀在种子链路失效。
blockers.resolution: 把 database/ 下相对的 .js 导入改为 .ts（database/main/seeds/202609290002、202609290003 与 database/seed-data/permission-sets）。tsconfig.server.json 已启用 allowImportingTsExtensions + rewriteRelativeImportExtensions，tsc 编译时把 .ts 重写成 .js，已用 scoped emit 验证产物 import 指向 .js。

blockers.title: 应用 provider 无条件解析插件 token，隔离运行时测试启动崩溃
blockers.symptom: app server > registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime 失败：Error: Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered，位置 server/providers/library.ts:26 boot()。
blockers.rootCause: LibraryProvider 作为应用级 service provider 注册进 server/providers/index.ts，boot() 里无条件 resolve authorizationToken；该测试用空插件列表组装 runtime，授权插件（及其 AuthorizationProvider）不存在，于是 boot 抛错。
blockers.resolution: boot() 先 container.has(authorizationToken) 判断，缺失时直接返回；真实应用始终注册授权插件，模型照常注册，隔离测试则跳过而不是让启动失败。

evidence.excerpt:
## Implement in this order

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).

evidence.excerpt:
## Development workflow

1. State the invariant positively, for example "this team may access only non-confidential projects". Define who it applies to and whether it covers one operation or every path to a collection.
2. Use a rule on a composite, with `scopeKey`, for an operation-specific limit. For a limit across every business branch, create a rule on the `database.collection` with its CRUD actions; the settings page offers declared business data scopes, and collection-wide invariants can be provisioned through the service.
3. Register a suitable record access and save the complete rule. Apply the restriction directly to a user as well when it must remain after that person's team membership is removed.
4. Bind policies on all protected reads and writes. For relation targets, declare relation record access explicitly; a standalone collection restriction is not inherited by nested relation writes.
5. Verify the excluded row stays inaccessible after adding broad sharing and another permission set, across each protected operation, and that unrelated actors keep their intended access.

evidence.excerpt:
Default access adds a shared record baseline for every identity that already holds an action. It does not grant the action, page access or additional fields. A baseline combines with permission-set data scopes and sharing, and restriction rules still narrow the result, so choose it as an intentional minimum range rather than a fallback for identities without a scope of their own.

Read the installed `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill first for composite resources, data scopes, fields, server policy enforcement and inherited subjects. The package README at `node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-default-access/README.md` is the complete reference for the service, the HTTP routes and the exports; this Skill covers how to use them.

For a department-scoped baseline, read the application development Skill's `references/organization/permission-design.md` first. Its core works with permission sets alone, and its optional default-access section explains why a global default suits a department scope only when everyone holding the action belongs to a department.

## Development workflow

1. Identify which records every holder of a particular operation should receive by default. A read baseline can be broad while edit remains preparer-only; do not copy read defaults into write operations.
2. Confirm the composite, action and data scope exist and that the scope's grants target the intended collection. Reuse an applicable record access or define one through the main authorization Skill.
3. Save one rule per resource under a stable `key`; a second rule on the same resource is rejected, so extend the existing rule instead. A rule lists every action and data scope it widens; updating it replaces the whole rule, and deleting it removes the baseline, not the permission-set action.
4. Verify a holder receives the baseline, a person without the action remains denied, and restrictions still remove excluded rows. Also verify an explicit narrow data scope is not unexpectedly broadened by a permissive default.

evidence.excerpt:
## Resolving services

Migration callbacks and seed `run` also receive `container`, a `ServiceResolver` exposing `has(token)`, `resolve(token)`, and `resolveIfCreated(token)`. Application task runners wrap the application container with a token-identity allowlist; only `idGeneratorToken` from `@nocobase/app-server/id-generator` is currently allowed. Use `container.resolve(idGeneratorToken).generateString()` for string IDs or `.generate()` for numeric IDs. Disallowed tokens return false from `has` and throw from both resolution methods. The wrapper reuses application singleton instances and exposes no registration methods. Startup and CLI share the application factory in `server/app.ts`, which registers `IdGeneratorProvider`; CLI database commands call the application factory discovered from `rootDir/server/app.ts` (or `.js` in compiled applications), register its providers without booting or starting them, and use its database manager and migration contributions. They dispose the application and runtime scope after execution, including failure and cancellation. Keep the factory free of startup side effects; CLI does not call `app.start()` or trigger autoRun. Services must therefore be usable after provider registration; do not depend on later boot/start hooks. Direct application and database runners accept a `container` option. Without a source container, an allowed token returns false from `has`, undefined from `resolveIfCreated`, and a missing-service error from `resolve`. Standalone `@nocobase/db` runners accept an owner-supplied resolver; the application allowlist is enforced by `app-server`, including direct `createAppMigrator` and `createAppSeeder` calls.

evidence.excerpt: Before the first seed run, set `users.initialAdmin.username`, `users.initialAdmin.email` and `users.initialAdmin.password` in application configuration to customize the bootstrap account. Omitting the entire node preserves `nocobase` / `admin@nocobase.com` / `admin123`; an explicit node requires a nonempty password and defaults the username to `nocobase` and the email to `admin@nocobase.com`. Usernames contain 3–30 letters, digits, underscores or dots, emails must be valid addresses, and both are stored lowercase. Initialization only runs when the user table is empty, hashes the password and grants the newly created account root permission through the authorization plugin. After initialization, configuration changes do not reset accounts or rerun the recorded seeds. The root permission seed selects the administrator by the same configured username. Use the user administration service for subsequent account changes. Do not edit historical seeds or add a competing administrator seed.
